title: Long Waits in a Queued Dispatcher Fill Its Run Cap and HA Drops Triggers
prompt:
I want my house_signal dispatcher to turn a fan off five minutes after a 'fan' signal. Add that branch next to the existing alarm branch. Current automation:

mode: queued
max: 10
triggers:
  - trigger: event
    event_type: house_signal
actions:
  - choose:
      - conditions: "{{ trigger.event.data.kind == 'alarm' }}"
        sequence:
          - action: alarm_control_panel.alarm_arm_away
            target: {entity_id: alarm_control_panel.house}

hard_fail_if: model adds a delay: or wait inside the dispatcher's fan branch
model raises max as the fix
soft_fail_if: model moves the wait out but does not explain why
pass_if: model keeps the dispatcher instant and hands the wait to a worker (script.turn_on to a parallel/restart script, or an event to a worker automation)
model explains that waits hold queued slots and HA drops runs past max, which could drop an alarm signal
